decisions.why: the eight existing gates call the provider directly, so they cannot see the registry schema, the validation function, or the handler argument map — where two real defects lived
decisions.surface: the text block the agent READS, not the internal report shape
decisions.schema: asserted as a first-class contract, because for an MCP client inputSchema is the only documentation channel there is
decisions.runtime: bun-only, because src/mcp/server.ts self-starts behind import.meta.main

limitations: This gate needs a spawned stdio server, so it is slower and heavier than the other eight. It is a wire gate by construction and cannot be made into a unit test without ceasing to test the wire.

It exercises the SOURCE tree (bun src/mcp/server.ts), not the compiled dist bundle. A stale dist would therefore not be caught here; the bundle is a separate build artifact and is verified by its own build step.
